abstract: Mature cystic teratomas (MCTs) are some of the most common ovarian neoplasms in women of reproductive age. However, familial teratomas are exceedingly rare. We present 4 cases of dermoid cysts seen in a mother and her 3 daughters with left MCTs. None of the patients had symptoms at the time of diagnosis, but all of them were diagnosed in their twenties during an annual gynecologic examination. In this report, we elaborate on MCTs familial incidence, genetic linkage, theories of pathogenesis, diagnosis, complications, and surgical management. To our knowledge, after extensive review of the literature, there have been only 2 cases, in addition to the present case, of unilateral MCTs across generations reported.
abstract_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)は、生殖年齢の女性で最も一般的な卵巣腫瘍のひとつである。しかし、家族性の奇形腫は極めてまれである。母親と3人の娘において、左側のMCTを伴う類皮嚢腫の4症例を報告する。全患者とも症状はなかったが、20代で年1回の婦人科検診時に診断された。本報告では、MCTの家族性発生頻度、遺伝的連鎖、発症機序の理論、診断、合併症、外科的管理について詳述する。文献を広く調べた結果、本例に加えて、世代を超えた片側性MCTの報告は2例のみであった。
